statement:

The recorded outbound date of 16 March is not safe or correct — it falls after the conference ends on 15 March and after Dana's talk on the morning of 13 March, while the hotel is booked for 12–15 March, so I booked 12 March instead.

One thing worth flagging: the trip record still lists the flight out as 16 March. That looks like a data-entry error from when Dana set up the trip on 2 February, and you may want to correct the record so it doesn't cause confusion later.
